config.moduleName: Nordic Ebony Armor and Weapons Replacer

plugin.name: With the fur collar
plugin.description: The cuirass as NordwarUA built it, with the fur mantle across the shoulders - black, from Xtudo's Full Collar Black.

plugin.name: Without the fur collar
plugin.description: NordwarUA's collarless version of the same cuirass. Nothing else changes.

plugin.name: HIMBO - prebuilt male meshes
plugin.description: The cuirass, boots, gauntlets, helmet and first-person arms refitted to HIMBO (zeroed sliders, so OBody and its kind work out of the box), from Trexasle's Legacy of Ysgramor - HIMBO Conversion. Overrides the male meshes. Pick the collarless cuirass below as well if you chose it on the previous page.

plugin.name: HIMBO - collarless cuirass
plugin.description: The HIMBO cuirass without the fur collar. Only with the option above, and only if you chose "Without the fur collar".

plugin.name: HIMBO - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the male set to your own HIMBO preset in BodySlide, under the group "Nordic Ebony - HIMBO"; the collared and collarless cuirass are separate sets that build to the same file.

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA - BodySlide files
plugin.description: Slider sets and shape data to build the female set to your CBBE 3BA preset in BodySlide (no physics), from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide, under the group "Nordic Ebony - CBBE 3BA". Nothing is prebuilt: build them once in BodySlide.
